data.name: David
data.gender_notes: David is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of David is recorded in name-lists as “Beloved”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: David expresses “Beloved”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of David total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
data.cultural_impact: David is used in Hebrew naming tradition with the meaning “Beloved”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to David is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Beloved” is the basis of any symbolism attached to David; such symbolism is interpretive.
